description: This file contains helper functions, type definitions, and configuration adapters for managing channel configurations, account permissions, and security policies within a plugin SDK for a chat or communication platform. It includes functions for resolving configurations, authorizing writes, and creating flexible adapters for different channel and account structures.

methods.name: formatPairingApproveHint
methods.description: Generates a formatted hint string for pairing approval commands.

methods.name: buildAccountScopedDmSecurityPolicy
methods.description: Constructs a security policy object for account-specific DM security settings.

methods.name: resolveChannelConfig
methods.description: Resolves channel configuration from the main config object based on channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelAccountConfig
methods.description: Resolves account-specific configuration within a channel.

methods.name: listConfigWriteTargetScopes
methods.description: Returns a list of configuration write scopes based on the target.

methods.name: resolveChannelConfigWrites
methods.description: Determines if configuration writes are permitted for a given channel and account.

methods.name: authorizeConfigWrite
methods.description: Checks if a configuration write operation is authorized based on origin and target scopes.

methods.name: canBypassConfigWritePolicy
methods.description: Determines if the current client can bypass config write restrictions.

methods.name: formatConfigWriteDeniedMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly message explaining why a config write was denied.

methods.name: createScopedAccountConfigAccessors
methods.description: Creates accessors for account allowlist and default target configurations.

methods.name: createNamedAccountConfigBase
methods.description: Builds CRUD helpers for named account configurations within a section.

methods.name: createChannelConfigAdapterWithAccessors
methods.description: Creates a channel config adapter with account allowlist and default target accessors.

methods.name: createChannelConfigAdapterFromBase
methods.description: Creates a channel config adapter from a base CRUD adapter.

methods.name: createScopedChannelConfigBase
methods.description: Builds CRUD helpers for channels with multiple accounts.

methods.name: createScopedChannelConfigAdapter
methods.description: Creates a full channel config adapter for account-scoped channels.

methods.name: createTopLevelChannelConfigBase
methods.description: Builds CRUD helpers for top-level single-account channels.

methods.name: createTopLevelChannelConfigAdapter
methods.description: Creates a full config adapter for top-level single-account channels.

methods.name: createHybridChannelConfigBase
methods.description: Builds CRUD helpers for channels with default account at root and named accounts under 'accounts'.

methods.name: createHybridChannelConfigAdapter
methods.description: Creates a hybrid channel config adapter with allowlist and default target accessors.

methods.name: createScopedDmSecurityResolver
methods.description: Builds a resolver for account-specific DM security policies.
